subject: English
question_text: Read the following sentences and put them in correct order.
stimulus: (a) The woodcutter answered in the negative both the two times and the goddess being satisfied with his honesty, gave him all the three including the real axe. (b) One day while cutting wood a river, suddenly his axe slipped out of his hand and fell into deep water. (c) His crying drew the attention of the water-goddess who took pity on him. (d) Once there lived a poor woodcutter who was very honest. (e) The man was very grieved and began to weep bitterly at the loss of the axe, the only means of his livelihood. (f) Then diving again brought a silver axe and asked the same question if it was his one. (g) Everyday he went to the jungle to cut wood and earned his livelihood by selling the wood in the market. (h) She, diving into the water, brought a golden axe and asked him if it was his one.
guide_solution: d → g → b → e → c → h → f → a
